drhp.business: Indef Manufacturing Limited designs, manufactures, and distributes a comprehensive range of overhead material handling solutions, including mechanical and electric hoists, cranes, and storage systems. The company serves a wide spectrum of industries—from automotive and energy to logistics and food processing—catering to large corporations, EPC contractors, and MSMEs. Its multi-brand portfolio, supported by a pan-India distribution network and growing international presence, addresses varied customer needs for productivity, safety, and efficiency.
